subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter guidance, and recommended artifacts
messages:
From: Jake Turner <jake.turner@finexco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Julie Ramos <julie.ramos@finexco.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and transfer options

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you had a good week. We're starting our security review for an upcoming procurement with FinexCo and need a copy of Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report covering at least the last 12 months of controls. Can you confirm the audit period covered and whether you provide a bridge letter if the report doesn't cover our required window?

We typically accept:
- PDF copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed)
- Bridge letter or management assertion for gap coverage
- Control matrix mapping (CSV or spreadsheet)
- Sample telemetry/log extracts for a small date range

Preferred transfer: presigned S3 link or SFTP. We can also accept a secured Share link. Our deadline for review is June 30; would you be able to share materials by next week?

I've attached a short intake worksheet indicating the items we prioritize and internal contact details.

Thanks,
Jake Turner
Senior Security Analyst
FinexCo

Attachments: finexco-intake-worksheet.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jake Turner <jake.turner@finexco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and transfer options

Hi Jake — thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet.

Short answers up front:
- Audit period: our most recent SOC 2 Type II covers 2024-03-01 through 2025-02-28.
- Bridge letter: yes, we can provide a management bridge letter to attest coverage between the end of the report period and the present; it typically includes the statement of continuity for controls and any material changes.
- Transfer: presigned S3 link works well for us; we can also support a secure Share URL.

What we'll share by next Wednesday (2025-06-18) assuming internal approvals go through:
1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — redacted only for customer-specific data if necessary.
2) Management bridge letter (PDF) — sample included for your review.
3) Control coverage matrix (CSV) — maps controls to our policies/processes.
4) Policy snapshots (PDFs) — InfoSec, Access Control, Change Management.
5) Short telemetry sample (gzipped CSV) — anonymized event counts for a 48-hour window.

Attachments and examples we'll include: a one-page bridge-letter template (bridge-letter-sample.pdf), a recommended artifact checklist (requested-artifact-list.csv), and secure-transfer instructions. For very sensitive items we can also execute a limited-access DPA addendum; let us know if FinexCo requires that.

Below are two brief reply templates you can use internally when filing the package into your procurement system — copy/paste as needed.

Template A — short confirmation for procurement:
"Redwood has provided the SOC 2 Type II report (period 2024-03-01 to 2025-02-28), a management bridge letter to cover controls through 2025-06-18, and a control matrix. Materials are available via presigned S3 link."

Template B — ask for limited follow-up:
"We've received Redwood's SOC 2 package. We may request a telemetry sample for 2025-05-12 to validate logging coverage; Redwood is the contact for delivery and redaction questions."

Logistics and security notes:
- We'll upload artifacts to an S3 bucket with 7-day presigned URLs and optional IP restrictions.
- Bridge letters are signed by our Head of Compliance (electronic signature).
- If you prefer encrypted transfer, we can provide a password-protected archive; share a public key or tell us your preference.

I'll start the package and aim to send the presigned links tomorrow afternoon. Looping in Marissa for the telemetry sample prep and Rishi for policy copy.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bridge-letter-sample.pdf (attachment stub), requested-artifact-list.csv (attachment stub)
From: Jake Turner <jake.turner@finexco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and transfer options

Kimberly — perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround and the templates. We appreciate the bridge letter offer. Two quick clarifications:
1) For the telemetry sample, can Marissa send anonymized event counts only (no PII) and include a short README describing the field names?
2) For the presigned links, FinexCo prefers a link with IP restrictions if possible (we can provide the IP ranges).

If those are OK, we'll expect the package tomorrow and will aim to complete our internal review by June 30. If anything else is required on our side (e.g., an NDA or additional consent),I'll escalate to procurement.

Thanks again — talk soon.
Jake
